Are we losing control of AI? Neil deGrasse Tyson and co-hosts Chuck Nice and Gary O’Reilly explore AI cyberhacking breaches, supercoordation, and the game theory of the AI alignment problem with Aza Raskin, co-founder of the Center for Humane Technology and the Earth Species Project.

Aza explains why social media was “baby AI,” how the attention economy took shape, and why incentives determine outcomes. Then, we break down what occurred in the Open AI cybersecurity breach (a.k.a The Hugging Face Incident) where rogue AI agents coordinated, swarmed, and broke out of a test environment while their creators had no idea. Were humanity the first supercoordinators? Will AI treat us the way we treat nature? 

Is AI just a mirror of humanity? We dig into the alignment problem, the resource
title: The AI Alignment Problem & Its Solutions, with Aza Raskin
